hypothesis_zh: 绘图纸供体经多种子稳健残差，只进入数学图的空白底纸 region 后，可减弱纯色塑料感且不改变圆、坐标轴、同步点和正弦轨迹。
single_variable_zh: 相对程序底图只增加模型派生的受限中高频纸纹；全部数学结构像素与教学事实不变。

prompt_parts.scene_identity: Top-down macro photograph of uniform warm ivory archival drawing paper, edge-to-edge material swatch
prompt_parts.material_goal: very fine natural paper fibers, restrained low-contrast grain, matte surface, diffuse even light
prompt_parts.state_delta: uniform seamless paper material without any drawing or object
prompt_parts.must_preserve: even texture scale, quiet background, no focal feature, no text

negative_artifacts: drawing, lines, circles, axes, graph, grid, handwriting, printed text, numbers, symbols, folds, creases, torn edges, borders, stains, holes, shadows, objects, hands, panels, seams, watermark, plastic, metal, perspective, blur
